home.meet_p1: Reflecting Journeys is born from more than twenty years of global experience — as a coach, entrepreneur, consultant and humanitarian worker across projects in psychosocial support, education, peacebuilding and conflict resolution.
home.meet_p2: Originally from Italy and now anchored in Beirut, Laura weaves together Western education and Eastern philosophy into one integrative practice. As a **Reflector** in Human Design — the rarest type, just 1% of people — she becomes your mirror, reflecting your own energy back to you with clarity and compassion.
home.why_p1: Energy therapy helps you reconnect with yourself beneath stress, conditioning, emotional overwhelm, survival mode and self-protective patterns.
